Intel–Apple deal boosts US stocks and chipmakers

Intel–Apple deal boosts US stocks and chipmakers US stocks (^DJI, ^GSPC, ^IXIC) are moving higher on Friday on news that Apple (AAPL) and Intel (INTC) are partnering to produce chips. Meanwhile, the stronger-than-expected April jobs report is expected to keep the Federal Reserve holding interest rates as Kevin Warsh prepares to take over as chair in a week. Other trending tickers include Micron (MU) and Moderna (MRNA).
